newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Payless ShoeSource raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Payless ShoeSource raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co analyst Michael Conn said Tuesday he raised his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Payless ShoeSource Inc to $3.13 a share from $3.10, which compares with $2.68 a share in 1996.
-- He also raised his fiscal 1998 estimate to $3.60 a share from $3.52.
-- He reiterated a strong buy rating on the stock.
-- Payless ShoeSource reported first quarter earnings of $0.81 a share, up from $0.60 a year, above Gruntal's expectations and the Street consensus.
-- Payless ShoeSource shares were off 3/8 at 45-7/8.
